caps.text: First: what's going on there right now?
caps.sub: Recent reports in and around Bangkok, on the map.

caps.text: Tap a report: what happened, and who said so
caps.sub: The outlet, the time in Zulu and local, and a link to the original.

caps.text: Circle the area around your hotel
caps.sub: Now the map and the list show only what's inside it.

caps.text: Take a brief of the area on the flight
caps.sub: Maps, reports and sources in one PDF, ready to read offline.

caps.text: Then let OSAP keep watch while you're there
caps.sub: Type the city and pick a distance.

caps.text: Save it, and OSAP checks day and night
caps.sub: Within minutes of new reports, with no account needed.

caps.text: Something happens near you? You get an alert
caps.sub: On screen, or as a push alert on your phone.

caps.text: One tap: the report, the place and the source
caps.sub: So you can decide what it means for your plans.
